name: EU Taxonomy — Data Centres (Activity 8.1)
source: EU Delegated Regulation 2021/2139 (Climate Delegated Act), Annex I, Section 8.1
notes: Technical screening criteria for climate change mitigation substantial contribution by data transmission networks and data centre facilities.

changelog.change: Added 2027 PUE review note; clarified CNDCP WUE formula

criteria.euCocNote: Registration as EU Code of Conduct for Data Centres Participant required

climateAdaptation.requirement: Physical and transition climate risk assessment required
climateAdaptation.note: Must assess heat stress, water scarcity, and extreme weather scenarios

circularEconomy.note: R2 or e-Stewards certification preferred. Chain-of-custody documentation required.

pollutionPrevention.requirement: Refrigerant management programme and emissions monitoring
pollutionPrevention.note: Cannot assume compliance — documentary evidence required

biodiversity.note: Required for new builds and major expansions
